answer: Anchor each identity's standing in a basalt record of peer-witnessed work: every verified task etched permanently by the peers who saw it happen, impossible to erase. At the gale force of an attack, clones flood in with no history behind them, so the network routes trust only through records at least two epochs deep. Willows of fresh identities are protected too - they simply wait, untrusted but welcomed, until their own record grows. A sybil farmer pays the full witnessed-work cost per clone while honest agents compound standing they already own.
